== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|[[Greatfather]]'s tears is a spring located at the summit of the [[Greatfather]] mountain, which features a peak shaped like a bottle mouth. The area is characterized by constant storms and serves as the source for the [[Dragon River]]. This pool contains a powerful [[water aura]] that can be utilized by favored elders of the [[Holy Wind School]] to restore their physical and spiritual vitality. While the spring offers restorative properties, such as increasing the density of one's [[spirit]] or rejuvenating the skin, it is also physically punishing and can cause intense pain to those who enter it.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Located at the summit of the mountain known as the [[Greatfather]], [[Greatfather]]’s tears is a spring that forms a pool used by favored [[Holy Wind]] elders to regenerate their vitality. The [[water]] possesses unique restorative properties, as a single handful can mend an aching body and a flagging [[spirit]]. [[Consuming]] two handfuls induces a three-day [[cycling]] trance that increases the density and potency of one's [[spirit]]. Additionally, the liquid can scour the skin like a frozen blade while leaving it youthful and supple.}}
